mapper.select: SELECT L.FORMAT_ID AS formatId, L.FORMAT_VER AS formatVer, L.ITEM_SEQ AS itemSeq, L.ITEM_TP AS itemTp, L.ITEM_ID AS itemId, L.ITEM_NM AS itemNm, L.DATA_TP AS dataTp, L.DATA_LEN AS dataLen, L.DATA_DECIMAL_PREC AS dataDecimalPrec FROM MCMAPUSER.TB_MCM_MOM_FORMAT_LAYOUT L INNER JOIN ( SELECT F.FORMAT_ID, F.FORMAT_VER FROM MCMAPUSER.TB_MCM_MOM_FORMAT_LIST F INNER JOIN MCMAPUSER.TB_MCM_MOM_TC_LIST T ON T.FORMAT_ID = F.FORMAT_ID WHERE T.TRANSACTION_CODE = #{transactionCode} AND (T.START_ACTIVE_DATE IS NULL OR T.START_ACTIVE_DATE < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (T.END_ACTIVE_DATE IS NULL OR T.END_ACTIVE_DATE > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (F.START_ACTIVE_DATE IS NULL OR F.START_ACTIVE_DATE < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (F.END_ACTIVE_DATE IS NULL OR F.END_ACTIVE_DATE > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY F.FORMAT_VER DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY ) FV ON FV.FORMAT_ID = L.FORMAT_ID AND FV.FORMAT_VER = L.FORMAT_VER ORDER BY L.ITEM_SEQ
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EAIUSER.${tableName} (TRANSACTION_CODE, INTERFACE_ID, INTERFACE_MSG, IF_FLAG, C_USR_ID, C_AT, C_SVC_ID, C_PGM_ID, U_USR_ID, U_AT, U_SVC_ID, U_PGM_ID, VER) VALUES (#{transactionCode}, #{interfaceId}, #{interfaceMsg}, #{ifFlag}, #{cUsrId}, #{cAt}, #{cSvcId}, #{cPgmId}, #{uUsrId}, #{uAt}, #{uSvcId}, #{uPgmId}, 0)

INSERT INTO MCMAPUSER.TB_MCM_MOM_TC_ERROR (SQ_VAL, TRANSACTION_CODE, INTERFACE_ID, INTERFACE_PROTOCOL, INTERFACE_MSG, ERROR_TYPE, ERROR_CODE, ERROR_MSG, ERROR_STATUS_CODE, C_USR_ID, C_AT, C_SVC_ID, C_PGM_ID, U_USR_ID, U_AT, U_SVC_ID, U_PGM_ID, VER) VALUES (MCMAPUSER.SEQ_MCM_MOM_TC_ERROR.NEXTVAL, #{transactionCode}, #{interfaceId}, #{interfaceProtocol}, #{interfaceMsg}, #{errorType}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMsg}, #{errorStatusCode}, #{cUsrId}, #{cAt}, #{cSvcId}, #{cPgmId}, #{uUsrId}, #{uAt}, #{uSvcId}, #{uPgmId}, 0)
